HEADLINE: Chase confirms it will become new issuer of Apple (AAPL) Card

BODY:

text: JPMorgan Chase has been confirmed as the new issuer of Apple Card, taking over from Goldman Sachs. Cardholders will retain existing features, including up to 3% unlimited Daily Cash back, Apple Card Family, access to a high-yield Savings account, and intuitive spending tools. Mastercard continues as the payment network, preserving global acceptance and network benefits. This transition suggests Apple is stabilizing its financial services partnerships after reported friction with Goldman Sachs, potentially improving customer service and program economics. Investors should watch for any changes to terms, rewards structure, or expansion of Apple's financial ecosystem that could affect Services segment revenue and customer loyalty.
